TY - JOUR AU - Susiana, Susiana AU - Kurniawan, Dedy AU - Rianti, Ulfa AU - Rapita, Rapita AU - Nugraha, Daza Septian AU - Edo, Edo AU - Rudin, Kamal AU - Aprilyanto, Bim AU - Wiradinata, Hardi AU - Dialam, Pangga Kurnia AU - Rochmady, Rochmady PY - 2021/11/21/ TI - Length and weight relationship bronze featherback ( Notopterus notopterus , Pallas 1769) in Sei Pulai Reservoir, Bintan Regency, Riau Island JF - Agrikan: Jurnal Agribisnis Perikanan; Vol 14, No 2, 2021DO - 10.29239/j.agrikan.14.2.353-357 KW - <i>Notopterus notopterus</i>, Growth pattern, Riau Islands N2 - Sei Pulai Reservoir is one of the sources of raw water for the people of Bintan Island, Riau Islands, to be precise in Tanjungpinang and its surroundings. Sei Pulai Reservoir is also a habitat for belida fish ( Notopterus notopterus ). The purpose of this study was to determine the relationship between length and weight of belida fish ( N. notopterus ) in Sei Pulai Reservoir, Bintan Regency. Sampling was carried out once a week from April to May 2021 based on fishermen's catch areas and fish habitats. The relationship between length and weight of male fish is W = 0,00000006L 3,4839 which indicates a positive allometric growth pattern and for female fish is W = 0,000002L 2,761 which indicates a negative allometric growth pattern.
